## Description

A polymorphic ciliate. The microstome form (~60 µm) eats bacteria with its small mouth; with the cue
released by other ciliates it transforms within hours into a macrostome, wider and with a large mouth,
that hunts those same ciliates.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

An [induced morph](../../mechanics/chemical-signals.md#m4--induced-morph) triggered by the *Tetrahymena* signal; a
few *Tetrahymena* per drop are enough. Transformation time, threshold, macrostome shape and mouth
estimated.
